dataset_spec.name: uci_wdbc
dataset_spec.description: UCI Breast Cancer Wisconsin Diagnostic (WDBC) cohort (569 observations, 30 real-valued nucleus features from fine-needle aspirate images).
dataset_spec.setting: Woman with a palpable breast mass who underwent fine-needle aspiration; the aspirate was imaged and the cell nuclei were outlined digitally. For each of ten nuclear features the observations give the mean over all nuclei, the standard error, and the 'worst' value (mean of the three largest nuclei).
dataset_spec.observations_header: Digitised fine-needle aspirate nucleus measurements (image pixel units unless noted):

radius_mean.scale_note: mean distance from centre to perimeter

radius_standard_error.scale_note: mean distance from centre to perimeter

radius_worst.text_label: Nucleus radius (worst, mean of the three largest)
radius_worst.scale_note: mean distance from centre to perimeter

texture_worst.text_label: Nucleus texture (worst, mean of the three largest)

perimeter_worst.text_label: Nucleus perimeter (worst, mean of the three largest)

area_worst.text_label: Nucleus area (worst, mean of the three largest)

smoothness_worst.text_label: Nucleus smoothness (worst, mean of the three largest)

compactness_worst.text_label: Nucleus compactness (worst, mean of the three largest)

concavity_mean.scale_note: severity of concave portions of the contour

concavity_standard_error.scale_note: severity of concave portions of the contour

concavity_worst.text_label: Nucleus concavity (worst, mean of the three largest)
concavity_worst.scale_note: severity of concave portions of the contour

concave_points_mean.scale_note: number of concave portions of the contour

concave_points_standard_error.text_label: Nucleus concave points (standard error over nuclei)
concave_points_standard_error.scale_note: number of concave portions of the contour

concave_points_worst.text_label: Nucleus concave points (worst, mean of the three largest)
concave_points_worst.scale_note: number of concave portions of the contour

symmetry_worst.text_label: Nucleus symmetry (worst, mean of the three largest)

fractal_dimension_standard_error.text_label: Nucleus fractal dimension (standard error over nuclei)

fractal_dimension_worst.text_label: Nucleus fractal dimension (worst, mean of the three largest)

diagnosis.question: Based on these fine-needle aspirate nucleus measurements, is this patient's breast mass benign or malignant on the confirmed diagnosis?
